subject: SRC: coarse public fallback can still become semantic authority during opening blackout
body: Current main 699ed292 source confirms the Gen6 patcher does not modify HingeAngleSource.kt or Fold7AngleAuthority.kt. Fold7AngleAuthority.offerPublic retains any fresh public candidate, and after the precise lease expires it calls promotePublic; promotePublic does not reject/suppress candidate.coarse. HingeAngleSource then updates lastAngle and emits AuthoritativeSample, while FoldOverlayService labels the downstream event accepted. Therefore a coarse public 90-degree fallback can still become semantic geometry during the opening precise-angle blackout. This is source-confirmed and directly aligns with the field false-90 symptom. Recommended narrow fix: opening-attempt-scoped coarse-public promotion guard BEFORE authority output; keep coarse samples as shadow-only while opening guard is active, fail toward no/current trusted authority, and lift on precise reacquisition or terminal opening end. Do not alter closing behavior. Instrument every candidate decision (accepted/shadow-only/suppressed/promoted/expired) with attempt/generation/source/angle/coarse/sourceAge/reason. Gen6 patcher must include these files or an equivalent source-side gate; suppressing only in FoldOverlayService is too late because authority.lastAngle has already mutated.
